history.label: History
notes: Loads the patient picked on the schedule (ignored whenever a chart is open)

sort.label: Smart Sort
notes: Removes an SL modifier when the patient is 18 or older (keeps it under 18)

coding.label: Coding
notes: Schedule mode: Add to EMR from the schedule — added/removed codes (incl. CPT removals and office-visit swaps), order, primary, modifiers (Smart Sort) and pointers (Link) in one save, then read back and checked
Schedule mode: patient list inside the panel — click 'Visit 1 of N ▾' to see the day's patients (time, name, type, dot) and pick one
Dots on the schedule rows for visits you've looked at (amber = changes, green = none, grey = locked)
Schedule mode (view only): on eCW's schedule, ECW Pilot's panel shows the visit you pick (click its row or use ‹ ›) with the same proposals as in the chart — chart not opened, nothing saved
Fix: proposals refresh once the visit's vitals and chief complaint have loaded

link.label: Link
notes: Plans pointers and SL for saving from the schedule
SL modifier only for patients under 18 (age on the visit day)
